# RAPP/1 — the wire that carries agents

> The interoperable protocol authority for RAPP: canonicalization, content addressing,
> identity, the frame, the egg. One wire tag, `rapp/1`. Stdlib-only reference implementation.

Start at the beacon, verify the chain, then read the materialized spec. Names like
`rev-14` are lookup labels; the frame hash is the identity.

## Verify first (machine entry)
- Beacon (selected head): https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/anchor/orient.json
- Chain (append-only DOGG): https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/anchor/chain.jsonl
- Index (seq → frame objects): https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/anchor/index.json
- Bootstrap profile + pinned verifier: https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/anchor/bootstrap/index.json
- How to resolve and materialize: https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/anchor/README.md
- Tick stream (Atom, discovery only, no CORS): https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1/commits/main/anchor.atom

## Read
- Materialized spec (byte-exact head view): https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/SPEC.md
- Reference implementation: https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/rapp.py
- Constitution (the law of change): https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/CONSTITUTION.md
- Prompt book (the human interface — copy-paste prompts, no code typed): https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/PROMPTS.md
- The book: https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/book/
- Source and issues: https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1
- Extending (your own estate, no change to rapp-1 needed): https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/EXTENDING.md
- Contributing: https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-1/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Discipline
- The chain is unsigned on purpose; authority is owner-ratified acceptance onto protected main.
- Pin by frame hash or full commit SHA, never by branch name; raw main is discovery only.
- Poll the Atom feed for change detection, not the GitHub REST API.
